newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega to reduce video game shipments in 97/98-paper.
newsitem.headline: Sega to reduce video game shipments in 97/98-paper.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd plans to ship three to four million units of its Sega Saturn video game machine next business year, down from expected total shipments of 4.35 million in the year to March 31, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun newspaper reported on Wednesday.
It said the move represented a retreat by Sega in the battle for the home-use video game market.
A Sega spokeswoman declined to comment on the report, and said the company had yet to decide its business plan for game machines for the next business year.

As of the end of 1996, Sega had sold a total of 7.16 million units of its 32-bit game machine, while its rivals, Sony Corp and Nintendo Co Ltd had sold 11 million and 3.99 million of their mainstay game machines respectively.
